idea.angle: Walk through a day: instant replies, qualification, bookings, follow-up, handoff
idea.hook: A day in an agency with an AI assistant done properly

slides.heading: **A day** with an AI assistant done properly
slides.body: This is the day we're designing for at Kortexa. Not a result yet. A blueprint, hour by hour.

slides.heading: A DM lands while you're **in traffic**
slides.body: Someone asks about a 2-bedroom in Spintex on Instagram. The assistant replies in seconds with price, location and photos from your own listings.

slides.heading: It asks the **right questions**
slides.body: Budget, area, move-in date, renting or buying. By the time you check your phone, you know if this is a serious buyer.

slides.heading: **The viewing** books itself
slides.body: The buyer picks a Saturday slot from your calendar and gets a reminder the day before. You didn't type a word.

slides.heading: I can't be everywhere at once.
Quiet leads get a **nudge**
slides.body: A buyer who asked about a Kumasi plot went silent two days ago. The assistant sends a polite follow-up with two similar options.

slides.heading: The handoff matters **most**
slides.body: When a buyer wants to negotiate or sounds unsure, the chat comes to you with a summary. The AI doesn't close deals. You do.
